prompts.prompt: Use case: production UI background material for Cyber Pop Campus, a Chinese campus computer-science roguelite. Generate ONE wide landscape blank dialogue-sheet BACKPLATE, aspect ratio 16:10, high resolution. No screenshot, no text, no letters, no icons, no buttons, no cards, no people. A restrained premium illustrated 2D game event dossier frame: pale warm ivory #F8FAFB main writing area, thin charcoal #17202B double-line outside border, tiny cyan #4AAFD0 circuit junction accents at the upper-left and lower-right corners, subtle matte paper texture. A narrow muted slate-blue strip along the left edge, folded-paper depth and a very subtle shadow. The large entire inner 94% area is blank, uniformly pale and calm so native dynamic text and controls will read perfectly. Straight crisp rectangular geometry with only slightly clipped corners, not ornate fantasy parchment, no torn holes, no glow, no chrome, no gradients that interfere with text. The canvas contains the backplate edge-to-edge, opaque ivory background. This is a reusable game UI asset that will be applied behind live controls, not a UI mockup.

Use case: production event illustration for Cyber Pop Campus. ONE portrait-oriented 3:4 illustration, edge-to-edge opaque background, no UI frame, absolutely NO text, letters, numerals, watermarks, logo, human figures or characters. An open campus field-repair supply case on a clean library worktable: one notebook with completely blank pages, a compact spare circuit board, a neat small screwdriver, three glowing translucent geometric code chips in red, cyan-blue and mint-green, safely arranged as valuable battle rewards. This is a stylized 2D editorial game illustration, confident ink contours, flat graphic shapes with soft restrained painted light, pale ivory and slate blue environment, teal highlights and one small warm golden accent. Strong simple readable central silhouette, slight three-quarter view, generous quiet top space and bottom space, no clutter, no accidental fantasy coins or weapons. It must feel like useful computer-science campus equipment recovered after a fight, inviting but grounded. The important case and its contents occupy the middle 65% and remain complete within a safe 12% margin so it can be displayed on the left of a game choice popup.

Use case: production event illustration for Cyber Pop Campus. ONE portrait-oriented 3:4 illustration, edge-to-edge opaque background, NO text, letters, numbers, glyphs, UI controls, watermarks, logos, people, faces or characters. A quiet campus library archive desk at dusk: a small clean computer terminal with a blank cyan screen, three translucent cyan data ribbons emerging gently above a physical open blank notebook, orderly books and a modest desk lamp, faint geometric window in the background. Central subject must be clearly recognizable as investigating computer memory and old system instructions, not a magical altar. Stylized premium 2D editorial game art with confident dark ink outlines, pale warm paper, slate navy, gentle cyan #4AAFD0 and extremely restrained muted magenta accents. Composed like an evocative roguelite event illustration: strong focused object scene, 12% safe margin, atmospheric depth, calm negative space, no dense circuits, no perpetual glitch, no fake text. Original campus visual identity, do not copy any existing game's art.
